# Modern Audio Co. (Modern Audio Private Limited)

> Commercial & Institutional Professional Audio Engineering, Acoustic Design & Systems Integration

Modern Audio Co. is a specialized commercial and institutional audio solutions provider based in New Delhi, India. We engineer, integrate, and calibrate turn-key pro-audio and acoustic solutions for large venues, educational campuses, corporate environments, hospitality facilities, and public spaces. We are a solutions engineering firm and systems contractor, not a consumer speaker retailer.

## Service Coverage
- Primary Hub: Delhi & National Capital Region (NCR)
- Project Delivery: Pan India execution for institutional and commercial projects

## Core Services & Solutions
- **Auditoriums & Performing Arts Halls**: High-intelligibility acoustic mapping, line array system design, stage monitor integration, multi-channel digital mixing, and speech transmission index (STI) optimization.
- **Educational Institutions & Lecture Theatres**: Clear vocal articulation, feedback-free wireless microphone networks, assistive listening, and hybrid lecture capture integration.
- **Enterprise Boardrooms & Conference Suites**: Beamforming microphone arrays, DSP echo cancellation, unified communications (Zoom / Teams Rooms) audio integration, and multi-zone distribution.
- **Hospitality & Experiential Venues**: Premium ambient background music, balanced multi-zone coverage, automated day/night volume control, and weather-resistant architectural loudspeakers.
- **Houses of Worship & Community Spaces**: Acoustic reverberation management, column line-arrays with tight vertical dispersion, and clear spoken-word projection across high-ceiling sanctuaries.
- **Live Event & Sports Venues**: High-SPL touring-grade sound reinforcement, robust system redundancy, and delay tower alignment.

## Systems Engineering Process
1. **Acoustic Assessment & Predictive Modeling**: Room geometry measurement, reverberation time (RT60) evaluation, and 3D acoustic simulation.
2. **Brand-Agnostic System Design**: Equipment specification based on architectural acoustics and client budget, without single-brand bias.
3. **Structured Cabling & Rigging**: Low-loss audio cabling, safe load-rated mechanical rigging, and EMI/RFI shielding.
4. **DSP Commissioning & Calibration**: Real-time analyzer (RTA) tuning, parametric EQ alignment, phase alignment, and limiter threshold configuration.
5. **Operator Handover & Lifecycle Support**: Staff training, documentation, and Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC).
